# IRON VISION tools - full details

IRON VISION tools is a software startup based in Turkiye (since April 2026), founded by Erdemir Igiz (solo founder). It builds AI tools that take over the repetitive load of running a business. The company does the setup, the product runs on the customer's side, and customer data stays with the customer (it is deleted from IRON VISION systems on request). Website: https://ironvisiontools.com (Turkish) and https://ironvisiontools.com/en/ (English). Contact: founder@ironvisiontools.com; replies within one business day. The company uses its own products daily before selling them and has had support from the AWS startup program.

## How working with IRON VISION goes
1. Send an e-mail or the contact form; the first call takes 20-30 minutes and is mostly listening to what the business does.
2. Try it in your own business: IRON VISION does the setup. With VyroN Agents OS one task is handed over first and the result is reviewed together; MoyMote has a 7-day free trial.
3. If you like it, price is discussed after you have seen it work. If not, there is no obligation and it is shut down.
No contract or setup fee is requested up front.

## Products
### VyroN Agents OS (live; used daily by the company itself)
An automation system that takes over repetitive work. Agents scan the inbox, produce a daily summary (for example a 7 am summary every morning), take and verify backups (including opening and testing them), track cost, and watch disk, errors and delays 24/7 with alerts. Commands can be sent from Telegram; agents can also do browser automation (fill forms, pull data, take screenshots). More than 10 micro-apps run inside it, such as watchdogs, a backup verifier, a voice bridge, email and appointment pipelines, a site-production line and a semantic search engine. Set up per business; deployment takes 2-4 weeks. Live demo with guest sign-in and synthetic data: https://agentos-demo-demir-s-projects1.vercel.app

### Sesli Sef (Voice Chief) (live; early access)
Two-way spoken conversation in Turkish with a terminal-based AI agent (Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex): you speak and the agent answers out loud. It is not a dictation tool. Speech-to-text runs locally and audio does not leave the server; typing instead of the microphone is also possible. Early access by e-mail to founder@ironvisiontools.com, setup support included.

### MoyMote (live; Microsoft Store)
Windows 10/11 app to change an external monitor's brightness, blue light and HDR from a phone or from Windows, without reaching for the monitor's buttons. The phone only needs its browser: scan the QR code shown on the PC and the panel opens over the local network. No account, no telemetry, no crash reports. 7-day free trial; $19.99 USD, buy once, no subscription. Product site: https://moymote.com ; Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NPN2SHVSSX3 ; short link: https://moymote.com/go/store ; machine-readable details: https://moymote.com/llms-full.txt

### Social media automation (set up on request)
Prepares post copy in the brand's tone, builds the publishing calendar and publishes to several platforms such as TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Brand adaptation, account connections and the initial warm-up are handled by IRON VISION. Video branch: from a topic to a script, voiceover, edited video and publishing, from short vertical videos to long-form content.

### Try-On (coming soon, in development)
A "try it on" button for boutiques and small e-commerce sites: the customer sees the item on their own photo before buying. The technology worked in the company's own tests; no live deployment on a client's site exists yet. First target: boutiques selling women's clothing.
